items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: He worked with Mongo Santamaria you know.

ctx.x: Did you have things over the years, something that would occur to you that I need to know more about — I mean I’m not specifically talking about music theory now, but a particular type of, oh I need to know more Latin music, anything like that?

Well I mean I did — when I was 17 I played with all the Latin bands in New York, at the Palladium. It was a wild experience for sure. And I talked to Chick about that because Chick came up a lot, same as me, with the Latin. He worked with Mongo Santamaria you know. So, and there’s a lot of influence in his playing from the Latin music, you know “Spain” and all that.
